headlines.headline: PISTONS AND JALEN DUREN AGREE TO FIVE-YEAR, $200 MILLION EXTENSION
headlines.detail: Detroit ended Jalen Duren's restricted free agency with a fully guaranteed five-year, $200 million deal after the center averaged 19.5 points and 10.5 rebounds on 65% shooting last season.

headlines.headline: BROWNS TOP STEELERS 27-24 ON THURSDAY NIGHT FOOTBALL
headlines.detail: Cleveland beat Pittsburgh 27-24 as Steelers DL Mason Graham exited with an MCL and ankle sprain, setting up a 3-0 vs. 3-0 Chiefs-Raiders showdown Sunday in the AFC West.

headlines.headline: WEEK 5 HEADLINED BY OHIO STATE AT IOWA, ALABAMA AT MISSISSIPPI STATE, NOTRE DAME AT UNC
headlines.detail: No. 5 Ohio State at No. 14 Iowa, No. 7 Alabama at No. 16 Mississippi State, and No. 3 Notre Dame at North Carolina lead a loaded Friday-Saturday slate.

headlines.headline: ACC TIPOFF SET FOR OCT. 5-7 IN CHARLOTTE WITH THREE TOP-10 TEAMS HEADLINING
headlines.detail: Three ACC teams sit in the preseason top 10 and four land in ESPN's way-too-early Top 25 as the conference's 18 programs ramp toward November tip-off.
